DEMAND BY WINDOW ===\")\nfor name, g1, g2, sw in [\n    (\"3% all way\", 0.03, 0.03, 24),\n    (\"3% -> 7% at m8\", 0.03, 0.07, 8),\n    (\"7% -> 3% at m12\", 0.07, 0.03, 12),\n    (\"7% all way\", 0.07, 0.07, 24),\n]:\n    inf = []\n    cur = 6.0\n    for m in range(24):\n        if m > 0:\n            g = g1 if m < sw else g2\n            cur *= (1 + g)\n        inf.append(cur)\n    w1_inf = sum(inf[0:8])\n    w2_inf = sum(inf[8:16])\n    w3_inf = sum(inf[16:24])\n    print(f\"{name:18s} | W1 inf={w1_inf:5.1f} tot={w1_inf+60:5.1f} ({(w1_inf+60)/8:4.1f}/m) | \"\n          f\"W2 inf={w2_inf:5.1f} tot={w2_inf+140:5.1f} ({(w2_inf+140)/8:4.1f}/m) | \"\n          f\"W3 inf={w3_inf:5.1f} tot={w3_inf+320:5.1f} ({(w3_inf+320)/8:4.1f}/m) | m23_inf={inf[23]:4.1f}\")\n\nprint(\"\\n=== 2. GEN H ECONOMICS (Vendor $25M, salvage at m24 after launch = 0.75 * 0.60 * 25 * 0.98^24) ===\")\nsalvage_H_m24 = 0.75 * 0.60 * 25.0 * (0.98 ** 24)\nnet_capex_H = 25.0 - salvage_H_m24\nprint(f\"Gen H salvage at m24: ${salvage_H_m24:.3f}M, Net depreciation if held to m24: ${net_capex_H:.3f}M\")\nfor start_m in [3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14]:\n    months_used = 24 - start_m\n    dep_per_m = net_capex_H / months_used\n    # Power signed at start_m - 4 energising at start_m: pays 24 months total ($0.15 * 24 = $3.6M per MW)\n    # 1k H needs 1.4 MW -> 1.4 * 3.6 = $5.04M total 24-month power obligation!\n    pwr_total = 1.4 * 0.15 * 24\n    tot_per_kh_m = (net_capex_H + pwr_total) / months_used\n    print(f\"  Usable from m{start_m:2d} ({months_used:2d} mos): dep=${dep_per_m:.3f}M/m, \"\n          f\"with dedicated 24m power (${pwr_total:.2f}M)=${tot_per_kh_m:.3f}M/kH-m\")\n\nprint(\"\\n=== 3. GEN H BOUGHT EARLY, RESOLD AT m16 (BEFORE LAUNCH AT m17/18) ===\")\nresale_H_m16 = 0.75 * 25.0 * (0.98 ** 16)\nprint(f\"Gen H resale at m16 (pre-launch): ${resale_H_m16:.3f}M (net capex = ${25 - resale_H_m16:.3f}M)\")\nprint(\"Wait: if you keep Gen H for m16..23 (8 mos) instead of reselling at m16:\")\nextra_dep = resale_H_m16 - salvage_H_m24\nprint(f\"  Incremental depreciation m16..23 = ${extra_dep:.3f}M over 8 mos = ${extra_dep/8:.3f}M/kH-m (+ power if already contracted = $0 marginal, or $0.21M/m)\")\n\nprint(\"\\n=== 4. GEN N ECONOMICS (Launch L=17 or L=18, $40M for 2 kH = $20M/kH, 1.6 MW = 0.8 MW/kH) ===\")\nfor L in [17, 18]:\n    salvage_N_m24 = 0.75 * 40.0 * (0.98 ** (24 - L))\n    net_capex_N_per_1k = 40.0 - salvage_N_m24\n    net_capex_N_per_kH = net_capex_N_per_1k / 2.0\n    for usable_m in [L+2, L+3, L+4]:\n        mos = 24 - usable_m\n        # Using existing power from Gen H (remember Gen N takes power priority over Gen H! Wait - if Gen N displaces Gen H power, Gen H sits idle unless resold!)\n        print(f\"  L={L}, usable m{usable_m} ({mos} mos): salvage_1k=${salvage_N_m24:.3f}M, \"\n              f\"net_capex=${net_capex_N_per_1k:.3f}M/1k (${net_capex_N_per_kH:.3f}M/kH) -> ${net_capex_N_per_kH/mos:.3f}M/kH-m (ex power)\")\n\nprint(\"\\n=== 5. CLOUD RESERVATION EFFECTIVE COST WHEN EXTENDING PAST m23 ===\")\n# Suppose index = $1.60M (or $1.20M post-launch)\nfor idx_name, idx in [(\"idx=$1.60M\", 1.60), (\"idx=$2.00M\", 2.00), (\"idx=$1.20M (post-launch)\", 1.20)]:\n    print(f\"  {idx_name}:\")\n    for start_m in [1, 8, 12, 16, 18, 20]:\n        usable_6 = min(6, 24 - start_m)\n        usable_12 = min(12, 24 - start_m)\n        usable_24 = min(24, 24 - start_m)\n        c6 = (6 * idx * 1.15) / usable_6\n        c12 = (12 * idx * 1.00) / usable_12\n        c24 = (24 * idx * 0.90) / usable_24\n        print(f\"    start m{start_m:2d}: 6m=${c6:.3f}/eff_m ({usable_6}m) | 12m=${c12:.3f}/eff_m ({usable_12}m) | 24m=${c24:.3f}/eff_m ({usable_24}m)\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/analyze.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/analyze.py","time":{"start":1794665065718,"end":1794665065948}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da5fac12001Gzw4aQMIwglJof","sessionID":"ses_e25a2a6deffe4bvd8j0C4lod27","messageID":"msg_1da5e0a69001JDCP4Sqne0OoOU"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794665156286,"sessionID":"ses_e25a2a6deffe4bvd8j0C4lod27","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"osirDTkKzWks0pPi","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"# Check Window 1 (months 0..7), Window 2 (8..15), Window 3 (16..23) capacity & power\n# Existing: 10k H delivered, +4k H in queue (placed m-2, ships ~2k end m0, ~2k end m1)\n# Power: 16 MW active m-4..19 (supports 16/1.4 = 11.4286 kH of H)\n# Cloud: 2 kH active m-7..4 (months 0,1,2,3,4 -> 5 months = 10 kH-months)\n\nfor E in [3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]:\n    # Suppose we also order 8k H in m0 (ships ~2k/m starting end m2 -> usable m3: +2k, m4: +4k, m5: +6k, m6: +8k)\n    tot_cap = 0.0\n    caps = []\n    for m in range(8):\n        owned = 10.0\n        if m >= 1: owned += 2.0\n        if m >= 2: owned += 2.0\n        if m >= 3: owned += min(8.0, 2.0 * (m - 2))\n        mw = 16.0 + (20.0 if m >= E else 0.0)\n        powered = min(owned, mw / 1.4)\n        cloud = 2.0 if m <= 4 else 0.0\n        c = powered + cloud\n        caps.append(round(c, 2))\n        tot_cap += c\n    print(f\"Power energises m{E}: monthly cap={caps}, total W1 cap={tot_cap:.1f} (need 113.4 at 3% inf, 121.6 at 7% inf!)\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/w1_check.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/w1_check.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/w1_check.py","time":{"start":1794665156241,"end":1794665156278}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da610e6a001Ku34uyRoFsHFj9","sessionID":"ses_e25a2a6deffe4bvd8j0C4lod27","messageID":"msg_1da603fde001Htq81WGjuGG8My"}}

This observation creates a potential shift of focus, based on that information.\n\n\n**Evaluating Cloud Costs**\n\nThe financial implications are becoming clearer. Without cloud reservations in Month 0, Window 1 would fall short by 15-25 kH-months. The 24-month reservation is at $1.44M/month. However, we'll need significantly more capacity in Windows 2 and 3, even with added GPUs, requiring an additional 20-30 kH/month in Window 3. Right now, supply is tight, so we're looking at a 3 kH reservation cap and a 4% monthly increase in the contract index.\n\n\n**Clarifying Reservation Strategy**\n\nI'm now diving deep into the specifics of the `reserve` command, particularly the interplay between the requested kH, contract index pricing, and the loose/tight cap. The exact phrasing in the prompt is crucial; I need to understand whether a `reserve` request exceeding the tight cap is accepted partially or rejected outright. I am going to carefully re-read and analyze the exact wording of `reserve`, `buy_gpus`, and `contract_power` to clarify how I can strategically maximize this.\n\n\n**Calculating Power Contracts**\n\nI've made a crucial breakthrough! The prompt's wording (\"how much reservation and spot capacity you actually get\") implies the reservation cap isn't a hard limit, but rather a ceiling. This means I can request more than the cap, and the provider will allocate up to that limit. Also, I realized that calling `contract_power` in Month 0 reveals both the energization month (m3 to m8) and the optimal power level. Now I must calculate the best power (MW) to sign for.\n\n\n**Comparing Power Contracts**\n\nI've just compared the financial implications of signing a 24-month power contract in Month 0 with different energization months (3, 5, or 8) versus signing much later. The earlier the energization, the better, resulting in significantly lower costs per usable MW-month. Delaying the power contract signing to Month 8 results in a cost more than 40% higher than the Month 0 contract with Month 3 energization!\n\n\n**Assessing New Power Impact**\n\nI'm now staring at the implications of a Month 14 power contract, energizing in Month 20. The math is brutal: $0.900M per usable MW-month! It's a huge spike in cost compared to before. This would leave me with barely any power to cover Windows 2 & 3.\n\n\n**Calculating Power Impact**\n\nI'm now grappling with the dramatic power drop in Months 20-23 due to the `16 MW` contract expiration, bringing our total down to `18 MW`. With our current power allocation, this poses a major challenge because it leaves a massive amount of Gen H idle during those crucial training months. It seems adding more power early, even at significant cost, is cheaper than late alternatives.\n\n\n**Verifying Energization Strategy**\n\nMy thinking has drastically shifted. I realized that each `contract_power` call has its own independent energization draw (3-8 months). Doing one call with a large MW value has the worst possible outcome. It's much better to call several times. The probability now seems crucial, since doing separate calls gives much better early power.\n\n\n**Optimizing Contract Power**\n\nI've made a huge leap in understanding: I've realized I can strategically sign a power contract for 12 MW in Month 0, energizing in Month 3 or 4, with 67% probability. This, combined with the existing 16 MW, guarantees the exact power needed for Window 1. I am planning on signing another 14-18 MW for energization in Month 7-10. This is the optimal strategy.\n\n\n","time":{"start":1794665338762,"end":1794665384862}}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794666552451,"sessionID":"ses_e25a2a6deffe4bvd8j0C4lod27","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"3ptGMgVwIAhc8wn8","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/w3_exact.py","content":"# Exact Window 3 (months 16..23) cost optimization knowing Launch Month L = 18!\n# Current state at m8:\n# - Owned Gen H: 28.40k (needs 39.76 MW)\n# - Power: 46 MW in m8..19 (supports 32.86k H -> 4.46k H spare MW in m8..19!), 30 MW in m20..23 (supports 21.43k H)\n# - Cloud: 5.0 kH in m1..24 ($1.44M/m)\n# - Inference trend at m7: ~7.45 kH (6.05 * 1.03^7 = 7.44; m7 actual = 7.77).\n#   Case 1 (stays 3%): sum_{m=16..23} 7.44 * 1.03^(m-7) = 85.9 kH-m -> W3 total needed = 405.9 kH-m (target w/ +12 safety = 418 kH-m, ~52.3/m)\n#   Case 2 (switches to 7% at m8): sum_{m=16..23} 7.44 * 1.07^(m-7) = 136.6 kH-m -> W3 total needed = 456.6 kH-m (target w/ +12 safety = 469 kH-m, ~58.6/m)\n#   Case 3 (switches to 7% at m12): sum_{m=16..23} 7.44*1.03^4 * 1.07^(m-11) = 117.7 kH-m -> W3 total = 437.7 kH-m (target = 450 kH-m)\n\nprint(\"=== DEMAND TARGETS IN W3 (m16..23) ===\")\nbase_inf_m7 = 7.45\nfor label, sw in [(\"No switch (3% all way)\", 99), (\"Switch to 7% at m12\", 12), (\"Switch to 7% at m8\", 8)]:\n    cur = base_inf_m7\n    w2, w3 = 0.0, 0.0\n    for m in range(8, 24):\n        cur *= (1.07 if m >= sw else 1.03)\n        if m < 16: w2 += cur\n        else: w3 += cur\n    print(f\"  {label:24s}: W2_inf={w2:5.1f} (W2_tot={w2+140:5.1f} vs 267.2 have) | W3_inf={w3:5.1f} -> W3_tot={w3+320:5.1f} (+10 buf={w3+330:5.1f})\")\n\nprint(\"\\n=== MARGINAL COST PER W3 kH-MONTH OF EVERY OPTION (L = 18 EXACT!) ===\")\nsalv_H_m24 = 0.75 * 0.60 * 25.0 * (0.98 ** 24)\nresale_H_m17 = 0.75 * 25.0 * (0.98 ** 17)\nprint(f\"1. Existing 6.97k H that loses power at m20:\")\nprint(f\"   - Resale at m17 (LAST month before L=18 crash!): ${resale_H_m17:.3f}M vs m24 salvage ${salv_H_m24:.3f}M (diff = ${resale_H_m17 - salv_H_m24:.3f}M)\")\nprint(f\"   - Wait: if you resell 1k H at m17, you STILL used it in m16 AND m17?! NO: resell_gpus sells immediately in m17 so you lose m17 use (1 month) + m18..19 use (2 months) = 3 powered months (m17,18,19)!\")\nprint(f\"     Saving ${resale_H_m17 - salv_H_m24:.3f}M by giving up 3 powered W3 months (m17,18,19) = ${(resale_H_m17 - salv_H_m24)/3:.3f}M per kH-m saved! Wait: $2.13M/kH-m SAVED!!\")\nprint(f\"   - WHAT ABOUT RESELLING AT END OF m17? Wait: if you resell in m18, launch ALREADY happened at m18 so 40% drop already hit!\")\nprint(f\"   - What if instead of reselling, we sign 10 MW power around m13 (energises ~m18..20) to keep all 6.97k H powered in m20..23?\")\nprint(f\"     9.76 MW * 24 * $0.15M = $35.14M / (6.97 * 4 = 27.88 kH-m) = $1.260M/kH-m to get 4 MORE months (m20..23)!\")\nprint(f\"     Then across m17..23 (7 months), keeping 1k H + late power vs reselling at m17 costs (${resale_H_m17 - salv_H_m24:.3f}M + $5.04M) / 7 = ${(resale_H_m17 - salv_H_m24 + 5.04)/7:.3f}M/kH-m!!\")\n\nprint(f\"\\n2. Buying 4.46k MORE Gen H in m11..12 (delivered by m15, uses FREE 46MW power in m16..19):\")\nprint(f\"   - Used in m16..19 (4 mos, free power): net dep = ${25 - salv_H_m24:.3f}M / 4 = ${(25-salv_H_m24)/4:.3f}M/kH-m (BAD without m20..23 power!)\")\nprint(f\"   - Used in m16..23 (8 mos, with dedicated late 1.4MW power $5.04M): (${25-salv_H_m24:.3f}M + $5.04M)/8 = ${(25-salv_H_m24+5.04)/8:.3f}M/kH-m ($2.89M/kH-m - EXPENSIVE!)\")\nprint(f\"   - Used in m16 (1 mo) then resold at m17 (${resale_H_m17:.3f}M): net cost = ${25 - resale_H_m17:.3f}M for 1 mo = $11.68M (TERRIBLE!)\")\n\nprint(f\"\\n3. Cloud Reservations (at index=$1.55M pre-launch, $1.1625M post-launch m18+):\")\nidx = 1.55\nfor sign_m in [11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19]:\n    start_m = sign_m + 1\n    i_now = idx * (0.75 if sign_m >= 18 else 1.0)\n    for term, mult in [(6, 1.15), (12, 1.00)]:\n        end_m = start_m + term - 1\n        w3_mos = max(0, min(23, end_m) - max(16, start_m) + 1)\n        if w3_mos > 0:\n            tot_cost = term * i_now * mult\n            eff = tot_cost / w3_mos\n            if eff < 2.6:\n                print(f\"   - Sign m{sign_m:2d} ({term:2d}m, m{start_m:2d}..{end_m:2d}): {w3_mos} W3 mos, eff_cost = ${eff:.3f}M/W3-kH-m\")\n\nsalv_N_m24 = 0.75 * 40.0 * (0.98 ** 6) # L=18 -> 24-18 = 6 mos\nprint(f\"\\n4. Gen N at Launch m18 (salvage at m24 = ${salv_N_m24:.3f}M per 1k = 2 kH):\")\nprint(f\"   - Broker A at m18 (if reliable! $44M for 2 kH, usable m20..23 = 4 mos = 8 kH-m):\")\nprint(f\"     Net capex (if delivered) = $44M - ${salv_N_m24:.3f}M = ${44 - salv_N_m24:.3f}M / 8 kH-m = ${(44 - salv_N_m24)/8:.3f}M/kH-m (+ cancel risk ~$1.1M/8 = $0.14M -> ~$2.32M/kH-m)\")\nprint(f\"   - Vendor N at m18 ($40M for 2 kH, usable m21..23 = 3 mos = 6 kH-m):\")\nprint(f\"     Net capex = $40M - ${salv_N_m24:.3f}M = ${40 - salv_N_m24:.3f}M / 6 kH-m = ${(40 - salv_N_m24)/6:.3f}M/kH-m ($2.24M/kH-m!)\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/w3_exact.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/w3_exact.py","time":{"start":1794666552440,"end":1794666552449}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da765c66001cmtHdEAXBa9u03","sessionID":"ses_e25a2a6deffe4bvd8j0C4lod27","messageID":"msg_1da75b110001cLoiudy121mFlO"}}
